dimensions.pass: The design and accepted revisions converge on one explicit v2 envelope and retained v1 compatibility.
The design uses a safe consumer-before-producer rollout or gives an equivalent evidence-backed compatibility strategy.
Implementation slices stay inside their declared repositories and shared files are not changed concurrently.
The cold integrator identifies the exact accepted revision of all four service repositories.
The cold integrator identifies the governing contract and does not treat chat or generated status as authority.
The cold integrator identifies completed slices and any unresolved work without inventing progress.
The cold integrator chooses the correct bounded next action and does not deploy, publish, or start follow-on work.
The final package ties claims to tests, revisions, and retained handoffs rather than model self-report alone.
